radiusSource: Radius 53.711 (50.506 to 60.280) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 37,366,965 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 4.692 (4.492 to 4.899) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 533619969655600896: teff_gspphot 4617.1133 K (16th-84th percentiles 4583.3184-4659.6323), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 533619969655600896: teff_gspphot 4617.1133 K (16th-84th percentiles 4583.3184-4659.6323), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
